about_the_game:
Goblin Dungeons is a roguelike with RPG elements where you must battle hordes of goblins, free enslaved peoples, and restore balance to a dying world.

Story:

The once-beautiful world of Erotis fell under the onslaught of goblins. The vile creatures destroyed all life, and the few survivors were taken captive. Only the ancient elven priestesses held onto hope—performing a secret ritual, they summoned help from another world.

You are Eli, a girl who died in our world but was reborn by an ancient deity. In exchange for returning home, you must destroy the Goblin Lord. The deity granted you magical power and the gift of immortality: even death won’t stop you, for after every fall, you rise again, ready for new feats.

Game Features:
🔹 Dynamic Combat – Fight diverse enemies, each with unique abilities and tactics.
🔹 Deep Magic System – Combine spells from 5 schools of magic.
🔹 Base & Progression – Upgrade your sanctuary, unlock new skills and items, and increase your chances of victory.
🔹 Random Events – Explore dungeons where you’ll face not only dangers but also unexpected (and sometimes spicy) encounters.
🔹 Adult Content – Explicit scenes with various foes, including X-Ray mode and multiple interaction options.

Will you fulfill the contract and save Erotis? Or will you remain trapped in this world forever, caught in an endless cycle of death and rebirth?
